summary.en: A ward certificate that confirms how family members are related. It is commonly needed for visas, scholarships, insurance claims and inheritance.
summary.ne: परिवारका सदस्यबीचको नाता पुष्टि गर्ने वडाको प्रमाणपत्र। भिसा, छात्रवृत्ति, बीमा दाबी र अंशबन्डामा प्रायः चाहिन्छ।

authority.en: Ward office of your municipality or rural municipality

eligibility.en: Any family member who needs official proof of a relationship.
eligibility.ne: नाताको आधिकारिक प्रमाण चाहिने परिवारका कुनै पनि सदस्य।

where.en: The ward office of your permanent address.

documents.en: Application letter to the ward office
Citizenship certificates of every adult listed (photocopies, originals for checking)
documents.ne: सूचीमा रहने सबै वयस्कको नागरिकता (फोटोकपी, रुजुका लागि सक्कल)

documents.en: Birth registration certificates of children listed
documents.ne: सूचीमा रहने बालबालिकाको जन्म दर्ता प्रमाणपत्र

documents.en: Marriage registration certificate, if a spouse is listed
documents.ne: पति/पत्नी समावेश भए विवाह दर्ता प्रमाणपत्र

documents.en: One recent photo of each person listed
documents.ne: सूचीमा रहने प्रत्येक व्यक्तिको हालैको एक प्रति फोटो

documents.en: Receipt showing this year's property or land tax is paid to the local level
documents.ne: स्थानीय तहमा यस वर्षको सम्पत्ति वा भूमि कर तिरेको रसिद

steps.en: Submit the application and documents at the ward office.
steps.ne: वडा कार्यालयमा निवेदन र कागजात बुझाउनुहोस्।

steps.en: The ward checks its records and may ask a family member to confirm in person.
steps.ne: वडाले अभिलेख जाँच गर्छ र परिवारका कुनै सदस्यलाई प्रत्यक्ष पुष्टि गर्न बोलाउन सक्छ।

steps.en: Pay the fee and collect the certificate signed by the ward chair. Ask for an English version if needed for a visa.
steps.ne: शुल्क तिरी वडाध्यक्षको हस्ताक्षर भएको प्रमाणपत्र लिनुहोस्। भिसाका लागि चाहिने भए अंग्रेजी संस्करण माग्नुहोस्।

amount.en: Set by your local level's finance act

tips.en: Embassies often want the English version attested by the Department of Consular Services. Get that done before your visa appointment.
tips.ne: दूतावासले प्रायः कन्सुलर सेवा विभागबाट प्रमाणित अंग्रेजी संस्करण माग्छन्। भिसा अन्तर्वार्ताअघि नै प्रमाणित गराउनुहोस्।
